summary: Frontend-only testing of 4 backup/broadcast enhancements on Hot Live 95 (license bypass via localStorage). All 4 features + regression PASS. Backup Health Badge correctly transitions Backed up -> Needs backup on dirty edit and back to Backed up after one-tap backup. Badge click opens the Backup modal. On desktop-Chromium web with no folder connected, backup-restore-button is correctly absent while backup-choose-folder and backup-now-button are present. One-tap backup downloads .hl95playlist and updates backup-last timestamp. Uninterrupted-air-note appears in Broadcast Center global bar with correct 24/7 desktop messaging. Regression: app-logo, single-file-save-toggle, open-backup-button all present; no runtime crashes.
action_items: Minor: React hydration warning 'In HTML, <span> cannot be a child of <option>' from StationsModal.js line ~407 (bitrate select). Emergent's data-* injection wraps the option label text in a <span data-ve-dynamic> which is invalid inside <option>. Not a functional blocker but pollutes console. Consider suppressing or using aria-label workaround.
critical_code_review_comments: App.js still 3450 lines - needs to be split into hooks/modules (backup, dirty-tracking, wake-lock, mediaSession).
backupToFolder still swallows per-playlist errors silently (from iter 41) - no partial-failure surfacing.
StationsModal option label emits invalid nested <span> inside <option> causing repeatable hydration console errors.
